name: Alert
description: An inline message about the state of a page or a task, with an optional action.

props.name: tone
props.description: neutral for information, accent for something new or in progress, danger for problems.

props.name: action
props.description: A button or link on the right.

a11y: danger alerts use role="alert"; the others use role="status", so they're announced without stealing focus.
Tone is carried by the icon and wording as well as color.
